thread:
Maria S: noticed dashboard heatmap + sparklines are super slow since this morning deploy, lots of timeouts in client console :grimacing: https://img.redwood.dev/XXYYZZ (small clip)
TJ: saw the same. top-level LCP and several chart paints jump after 08:12 deploy. console logs show repeated 429s to /api/v1/route and kvcache misses.
Ben: 429s -> routing quota? we're hitting per-route concurrency when many small chart tiles request prefetch at once. quota bounce causes requests to hit fallback route -> different kvcache keyspace -> cold cache.
Aaron: the routing-weight change in the canary might be contributing. current policy: `route_weight: {metrics: 0.6, default: 0.4}` — canary bumped metrics up and enabled adaptive-prefetch. snippet from rollout config:
```
canary:
  adaptive_prefetch: true
  prefetch_window_ms: 300
  route_weight: {metrics: 0.75}
```
Maria S: adaptive_prefetch was rolled to 100% at ~08:10 as part of the telemetry sampler rollout. didn't think it'd cause kvcache churn but makes sense.
Elena: Confirmed in traces: chart requests redistribute across 3 different model/route hosts when quota tripped. each host has separate in-memory prefix cache so thrash.
deploy-bot: deploy 6754321870 (telemetry-sampler-adaptive-prefetch) finished by Aaron at 08:09:56 UTC
TJ: logs (cropped):
```
[08:11:22] WARN route-quota: route=/api/v1/route code=429 active=128 limit=100
[08:11:23] INFO kvcache: miss key=heatmap:tile:usr123 host=h2
[08:11:23] INFO kvcache: miss key=heatmap:tile:usr123 host=h1
[08:11:24] WARN client: chart-render took=1450ms route-fallback=true
```
Ben: quick mitigation options:
- roll back adaptive_prefetch flag immediately (fast, low risk)
- increase per-route concurrency temporarily (risky for fairness)
- pin chart routes to a single routing pool to preserve kvcache affinity (needs config change)
Elena: we should aim for option 1 + 3 as short term. rollback buys time, pinning reduces cross-host misses.
Aaron: I can push rollback patch now, but we need a safe canary plan for prefetch later. prefetch_window_ms=300 might be too aggressive for dashboards with many small tiles.
Maria S: agree. prefer a canary strat that throttles prefetch rate and keeps affinity: `adaptive_prefetch: {enabled: true, max_inflight_per_user: 8, affinity_hint: true}`
TJ: also add telemetry marker so we can correlate kvcache host bounce in traces. otherwise it's noisy.
Ben: I'll add a runtime throttle override so SRE can flip without deploy.
Elena: action items: Aaron -> rollback now; Ben -> runtime throttle toggle; TJ -> add telemetry marker and dashboard to track host churn; Maria -> coordinate UX impact + hold canary until we've validated affinity. ETA 30m? :hourglass:
deploy-bot: rolling back deploy 6754321870 -> intent=rollback_by_Aaron initiated at 08:19:02 UTC
Aaron: rollback completed 08:22:11 UTC. initial dashboards look back to baseline, but leaving throttles on for 1 hour to validate.
Maria S: thanks team. we'll re-open if anything regresses, otherwise plan a controlled canary with affinity and reduced prefetch window next week. :thumbsup:
